caveats_c3: 1. Deletion irreversibility: in-tree modules removed on disk; recovery requires git history checkout. No on-disk fallback remains.

2. Fresh-install dependency: clean nexus install (or any environment where qmirror is not reachable via the 4 tiers) will hard-fail with exit 127. Pre-flight requires `hx install qmirror` or $QMIRROR_ROOT set.

3. Hard-fail not silent: when all 4 tiers fail, router exits 127 with structured error. Callers that previously relied on silent in-tree fallback will surface failure loudly (intentional behavior change).
4. Audit log enum change: `route` field no longer emits `legacy-intree`; log-parsing consumers must update.
